messages.text: I can check that for you. What's the order number and the email address on the order?

Got it. Your Magic M. 40T ships October 31, 2026, along with the Harlo OS diagnostics add-on on the same order. Nothing has left the warehouse yet, and you'll get tracking by email when it does. Anything else I can check?
Is there any chance of it shipping earlier?

Honestly, I can't promise earlier. October 31 is the date locked to your order, and it's already ahead of the current batch date, so you're in good shape there. Batches occasionally move up, and if yours does you'd get the shipping email sooner, but I won't quote you a date I can't stand behind.

If waiting is the problem, I can look at what's in stock and shipping in a few days instead. Want me to?
Understood. You're set for October 31, and tracking will hit your inbox when it ships. Just come back here if anything changes on your end.
